acquisition.pagination: Contiguous saved pages from page 1 under one explicit scope. Exact-count satisfaction and a final empty page are different observations; neither proves an atomic snapshot or complete amendment history. Approximate counts cannot close traversal; changing counters and repeated file IDs block review.

partitions.name: endpoint_capture
partitions.source: Credential-free capture.schema.json plus exact response/header digests and explicit observation-time basis.
partitions.purpose: Keep each endpoint's observation ancestry independent of all bulk releases.

acquisition.retry_policy: Manual Go capture requires explicit page/request/attempt/source-byte budgets, capped at 16 pages, 48 requests, 3 attempts/page and 16 MiB; 4 MiB/body and 128 KiB/headers. Serial requests wait at least one second. Retry transport/truncation and 429/500/502/503/504 within budgets; honor Retry-After or defer above 30 seconds/unknown delay. Request timeout 30 seconds, run timeout five minutes. Retain bounded failed bodies and credential-free attempt records; suppress detected credential echoes. Old-report reconciliation and recurring acquisition remain draft.

physical_schema.encoding: Strict UTF-8 JSON; reject duplicate object keys, unpaired surrogates and excessive nesting. Keep number lexemes, nulls and source string types.
physical_schema.null_policy: Preserve every present null, including fields without Swagger x-nullable. Missing keys are blocking shape issues. Invalid file/committee identities stay raw and block review.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: Pinned Swagger plus closed endpoint field sets in record.schema.json and compiled Go shapes. Nine explicitly listed monetary fields accept observed number or string representations; report amendment chains accept number/string members. Neither exception normalizes a value.

identity.publisher_record_key: file_number within one endpoint capture; never a first/last-wins map
identity.occurrence_locator: Endpoint capture digest + exact body digest + one-based results ordinal
identity.record_version: SHA-256 of exact raw result-object bytes before JSON re-encoding
identity.duplicate_policy: Keep every occurrence. Repeated file numbers within one capture block singleton use. Same file across endpoints remains separate assertions.

time_fields.meaning: Preserve reported dates/date-time text without guessing timezone or financial scope.
Keep received and processed-update assertions independent from coverage, cycle and observation time.
Explicit client clock or retained HTTP Date; never relabel server time as a client observation.

rules: Preserve all raw endpoint fields. This reader normalizes only valid positive file IDs and committee-ID syntax; no money, dates, flags or amendment references are converted.
Retain negative/self predecessor references, source nulls, number/string chain elements, conflicting flags and missing requested IDs.
Do not infer complete financial replacement, cash, unique transactions, absent filings or terminal allocation. Both readiness guards remain false.
No fetching, source pointer, fact publication, graph, or Dagster asset is introduced by the local reviewer.

revisions.publisher_model: Mutable processed endpoints may update old report assertions; endpoint fields can disagree in meaning and value.
revisions.effective_projection: Not implemented. Report-family closure, attachment handling, history refresh and reporting-scope acceptance are separate gates.

checks.rule: Verify explicit scope, observed-time basis, successful JSON HTTP headers, exact size/digests, confined paths and read budgets.
Preserve all rows and report missing/unknown fields, unreviewed types or invalid keys. Duplicate JSON keys reject parsing, not source retention.
Require contiguous pages; preserve exactness, reject changing counters, count contradictions and repeated file numbers.
All outputs remain history-incomplete and financially unselected, even after query traversal.

scenarios: Synthetic full-field metadata record; negative predecessor, nulls, false and zero are distinct.

use.retention: Retain original complete/bounded response bodies and credential-free attempt evidence separately from bulk releases. Go capture stores decoded header values, omits authentication/cookie headers, and explicitly suppresses detected credential echoes; it does not claim original wire header casing/order. Successful descriptors are immutable local files. Local review never changes artifacts.
use.disclaimer: Processed publisher metadata assertions, not accepted financial report membership. Bounded manual Go capture is implemented; acquisition remains draft pending history/refresh reconciliation and population coverage.
